_doc_note: Shape per the Perplexity Agent API docs, read 2026-10-05. https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/migrate-from-sonar: the Agent API (POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/agent) returns a typed output array, one item per step, with a search_results item for sources and a message item for the answer text; Sonar and Sonar Pro map to the fast preset; the model value below is the one in that page's example response to a fast preset request. https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/agent-post: a search_results item holds queries and results (id, url, title, snippet, optional date and last_updated, source); message content parts are of type output_text with annotations of type url_citation (url, title, start_index, end_index); status is one of completed, failed, incomplete, in_progress, queued, cancelled; there is no top-level output_text field (output_text is an SDK property). https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/tools/web-search: usage carries input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens and tool_calls_details.search_web.invocation when tool-call usage is reported. Every documented example response leaves annotations empty or absent while the answer text carries inline markers that refer to a result id, so the two populated annotations below follow the reference schema and are unverified against a live response. Hand-written, not a live capture.
